Hi Sam —

Welcome and thanks for choosing Redwood for the GreenValley integration. To get procurement and PO activation moving I need a few items from your side so Finance can create the vendor record and issue the initial PO: 

- Completed supplier diversity & sustainability questionnaire (attached PDF or spreadsheet acceptable)
- Signed W-9 (or tax form appropriate for your entity)
- Primary remit address and preferred payee name (must match W-9)
- Bank remit details or portal link if you require ACH onboarding (we send the PO regardless)

I've attached our supplier onboarding form to this message — please fill and return. Once we have the W-9 and remit data Finance will provision the vendor and generate PO. Our standard initial terms are net-30 unless otherwise agreed; please confirm any billing constraints.

If you prefer, I can send the DocuSign packet (forms + vendor T&Cs) — say the word and I’ll route it.

Key dates: onboard + PO issuance target: by EOW (Fri 08/08) if we receive docs by EOD Wed 08/06.

Thanks,
